newsitem.title: CANADA: Massive Canada-U.S. pipe group to hold open season.
newsitem.headline: Massive Canada-U.S. pipe group to hold open season.

text.p: Alliance Pipeline LP, a consortium of energy firms aiming to build a massive gas pipeline to Chicago from northern Canada, is scheduled to start gauging producer support for the project on Tuesday, the company said on Monday.

Alliance, which includes such companies as Gulf Canada Resources Ltd, Crestar Energy Inc, IPL Energy Inc and Petro-Canada, said it would launch its open season to seek transport commitments from shippers wanting to move gas production on the line.
Dennis Cornelson, Alliance's new president and chief executive, is to outline the process and give information at a news conference, the company said.

Alliance is aiming to build a 1.0 billion cubic feet per day liquids-rich gas pipeline to Chicago from northeast British Columbia, a 3,000 km route, by late 1999. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
